lines.t: As the mountains tumble, as the trees topple down
As the rocks split and break the ground
As the lightning flashes, the thunder roars
Your love remains and I know it always will
And I never have to worry
Cause you'll never leave my side
And I know your glory's never gonna hide
Lord, I know your love will never depart
Forever it will be in my heart
Your love endures forever
It will never leave
And for all eternity
I will have peace
Because I know your love's never gonna leave me
Forever, when I will see your love
Endures forevermore
Forever, forever
When the shadows loom, when darkness surrounds me
I can rest easy knowing your love has found me
And I know your love will always last
In the present, future, and past
Lord, I know your love is forever
And I know it won't leave me
It never
Well, your love endures forever
It will never leave
And for all eternity
Eternity, I will have peace
Because I know your love's never gonna leave me
Forever, I will see your love
Endure forevermore
Ooh
Ooh
Lord, I will never doubt
Cause your love's always about
And even in the night
Your love is a forever shining light
As the night closes in
When I don't know where to go
Or where to begin
I know I can turn to you
Because your love will never leave
And will forever be on my knees
Praising you, Lord
Because I know your love
Your love
Your love in me
Oh, oh, oh, oh.
